chapters.theme: Theme: Home, first hope, the call to adventure
chapters.narrative: The story opens on a quiet morning. The village is losing its colors. Apples fall from trees still green. The old grandmother no longer tells stories because the words feel heavy. Children play without laughter. The player lives a simple life until the wounded Firebird crashes into the garden.

chapters.theme: Theme: First danger, learning the rules of the wild
chapters.narrative: The forest is sick. Trees groan. Paths twist. The Leshy (forest spirit) is angry and confused because the Living Lights that once fed him are almost gone. He tries to trap the hero with illusions and moving trees.

chapters.theme: Theme: The ambiguous mentor, tests of character
chapters.narrative: The famous hut on chicken legs stands in a clearing that smells of smoke and strange herbs. Baba Yaga is waiting. She is not surprised. “I smelled pure light on the wind,” she says. “Come in… or don’t. I may eat you either way.”

chapters.theme: Theme: Beauty, restoration, first major victory
chapters.narrative: The Firebird leads the hero to her ancestral kingdom — a land of golden trees, singing rivers, and floating islands of light. But the kingdom is under attack. Dark vines choke the trees. Many of her sisters have been captured and turned into shadow-birds.

chapters.theme: Theme: Rest, friendship, and the beginning of love (or deep bond)
chapters.narrative: After the intensity of the Firebird kingdom, the road leads to soft, dream-like shores where the rivers run with milk and the banks are made of sweet jelly (a classic Russian fairy-tale image). Here the hero meets Vasilisa the Beautiful, who has been searching for a way to stop the fading of her own land.

chapters.theme: Theme: Wonder, adaptation, new rules
chapters.narrative: A great river leads down into the domain of the Sea Tsar. The world changes: gravity feels lighter, bubbles rise, currents push the gems in unexpected directions. New mechanics appear (floating tiles, current lanes, pearl collectors).

chapters.theme: Theme: Strength, inheritance, the bogatyr spirit
chapters.narrative: The stone belt of the Urals rises ahead. Here the hero first meets the spirit of Ilya Muromets — not yet the full legendary warrior, but a quiet, powerful presence who has been waiting for someone worthy. He trains the hero through a series of increasingly hard “strength” levels (stone obstacles, heavy chains, collapsing platforms).

chapters.theme: Theme: Loneliness, endurance, the spirits of the wild
chapters.narrative: The endless taiga. Days of travel through snow and dark pines. The Firebird’s light is sometimes the only warmth. The hero meets a great Bear spirit who has lost his cubs to the darkness. Helping him becomes a personal quest inside the chapter.

chapters.theme: Theme: Magic of the North, alliance with frost
chapters.narrative: The land of eternal winter and dancing auroras. Here live Father Frost (Морозко) and the Snow Maiden (Снегурочка). At first they are cold and distant — the fading of the Living Lights has made even frost spirits weaker and more irritable.

chapters.theme: Theme: National heart, unity, mid-game climax
chapters.narrative: A mythical, fairy-tale version of Moscow with golden domes that shine even in the fading world. The three great bogatyrs — Ilya, Dobrynya, and Alyosha — gather here for the first time in ages. The city is under siege by shadow forces.

chapters.theme: Theme: Beauty, elegance, deepening bonds
chapters.narrative: A dream-like vision of St. Petersburg — canals of pure light, white nights that never end, palaces of ice and glass. The atmosphere is refined and slightly melancholic. Here the relationship with Vasilisa (or another companion) deepens through quiet conversations and shared levels under the endless twilight.

chapters.theme: Theme: Sun, ancient memory, rising tension
chapters.narrative: Sunny shores, vineyards, and ruins of ancient cities. The light here is stronger, but so is the shadow that tries to corrupt it. The hero discovers an ancient prophecy carved in stone: the final battle will take place at the roots of the World Tree, and only one who has walked every land of Rus can open the way.

chapters.theme: Theme: Honor, courage, hospitality
chapters.narrative: Towering peaks and proud mountain spirits. The laws of hospitality are sacred here. The hero is tested not only by difficult vertical levels (new scrolling style) but by moral choices: help a stranger, keep a promise, face fear without running.

chapters.theme: Theme: Purity, depth, revelation
chapters.narrative: The deepest and purest lake in the world. Its waters hold ancient memory. The hero must dive into both surface and underwater levels to cleanse the pollution of darkness. The Master of Baikal — an ancient, almost divine spirit — tests the hero’s purity of heart.

chapters.theme: Theme: The edge of the world, new allies, approaching storm
chapters.narrative: Where Slavic lands meet the Pacific spirits. New visual language, dragon-like creatures, and different magical traditions. The hero forges an alliance with the eastern spirits. Zmey Gorynych appears in full terrifying power as a multi-headed boss.

chapters.theme: Theme: Descent, sacrifice, dark beauty
chapters.narrative: The hero descends into the roots. The atmosphere becomes heavy, beautiful, and dangerous. Here live the spirits of those who died protecting Rus. The three bogatyrs appear again, but as luminous spirits who can only guide, not fight fully yet.

chapters.theme: Theme: Ascent, reunion, growing power
chapters.narrative: Climbing the endless trunk. Allies from almost every previous chapter return to help — Leshy, the Sea Tsar’s gift, the Bear spirit, Morozko’s frost, the eastern dragons, and the three bogatyrs in growing strength. The levels become larger and more collaborative in feel.

chapters.theme: Theme: Divine light, final preparation, blessing
chapters.narrative: The upper world. Halls of pure light, where the highest spirits and the memory of the old gods still linger. The hero receives the final blessing and the ultimate form of Matching Magic — the ability to create Living Lights that can permanently push back darkness.

chapters.theme: Theme: Darkness, despair, the ultimate test
chapters.narrative: Almost all color is gone. The boards are dark, the music is heavy, the difficulty is the highest in the game. Companions are temporarily separated or weakened. The hero must fight through nightmare versions of previous locations — twisted forests, frozen villages, shadowed Moscow.

chapters.theme: Theme: Triumph, sacrifice, new beginning
chapters.narrative: The final battle. All companions return. The three bogatyrs fight at full power. Baba Yaga arrives in her mortar with unexpected help. The Firebird burns with her complete golden fire. Vasilisa stands beside the hero. The Matching Magic reaches its peak — entire boards can be cleared in cascades of pure light.
